title: platanthera bifolia var. pervia
intro: Platanthera bifolia var. pervia, commonly known as the greenbell orchid, is a rare and endemic species of orchid found in the mountainous regions of the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. The greenbell orchid has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including the treatment of respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and pneumonia, due to its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of the greenbell orchid include its ability to reduce inflammation, relieve coughs, and ease congestion, making it a valuable remedy for respiratory health. Bioactive constituents of the greenbell orchid include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
